changelog:
Add atomic bulk scheduled-cue deletion with active-lifecycle protection and retained-history preservation
Add atomic bulk Skip Next and clear-skips actions for selected scheduled cues with all-or-nothing eligibility and persistence safety
Add spreadsheet-ready credential-free CSV exports for occurrences, conflicts, scheduled-cue history, and playback history with filter-preserving report scope
Add atomic bulk scheduled-cue enable/disable with administrator multi-selection and all-or-nothing persistence safety
Add credential-safe support bundle export combining diagnostics, target validation, runtime telemetry, histories, scheduler status, and redacted configuration metadata
Add cancellation-aware administrator support-bundle collection with explicit private-metadata warning
Add configurable 7/31/90/366-day schedule report horizons across tables, JSON diagnostics, and iCalendar export
Add downloadable credential-free occurrence and conflict JSON diagnostics
Add cue-scoped upcoming occurrence, calendar, and retained-history administrator filters
Add credential-safe configuration import preflight and administrator migration validation
Add outcome-filtered scheduled-cue history and focused administrator telemetry controls
Fix cue-scoped scheduled-cue conflict diagnostics and add a focused administrator conflict selector
Add credential-free scheduled-cue conflict diagnostics with duration-aware overlap guidance
Make scheduled-cue skip and one-time completion transitions fail safe on persistence errors
Make global settings, saved-scene, and scheduled-cue persistence transactional with rollback on failure
See CHANGELOG.md for the complete release history
description: Synchronize Philips Hue lights with your media playback in real-time.
name: Philips Hue Sync
overview: Adds support for real-time lighting synchronization with Philips Hue Entertainment Areas using the streaming DTLS API. Features cinema mode, solid, breathing Pulse, hue-cycling Rainbow, and warm flickering Candle scene previews with bounded 25-400% animation speed controls, optional bounded fade-in and fade-out transitions and administrator cancellation, immediate all-enabled-target preview fan-out with sequential restorative execution and per-target telemetry, credential-free saved-scene preview actions and API resolution against default, selected, or all enabled targets, reusable ordered saved scene playlists with bounded repeat passes, complete credential-free saved-scene, saved-playlist, and per-user mapping dependency audits including playlist-backed scheduled cues, administrator cue-reference inspection, transactional global-settings, saved-scene, per-user mapping, and scheduled-cue persistence with rollback on failure, fail-safe scheduled skip and one-time completion transitions, duration-aware scheduled-cue conflict diagnostics with time-zone-aware ordering guidance and cue-scoped filtering, configurable 7/31/90/366-day schedule report horizons, downloadable credential-free occurrence and conflict JSON diagnostics, cue-scoped upcoming occurrence and calendar previews, cue- and outcome-filtered history and exports, spreadsheet-ready credential-free CSV exports for occurrence, conflict, scheduler-history, and playback-history telemetry with filter-preserving report scope,
